messages:
mia: Quick sync — need to lock down edge-case matrix for gen API (streaming / truncation / token-limits / retries). Who can own the PRD+RFC?
raj: From runtime POV biggest risk is resume when a stream is truncated mid-token and client retries. Need a clear contract.
elena: Acceptance criteria draft: preserve token continuity (no dups); retries idempotent or explicit non-resumable; truncation emits deterministic cutoff flag.
thomas: Customers want deterministic partial outputs + clear status codes. Proposal: response headers `X-Gen-Status: complete|partial|truncated|nonresumable` and `X-Idempotency-Key` in logs.
sophie: Support queue has many "duplicate completions" tickets after flaky networks. Need idempotency + SDK guidance.
mia: Prioritization P0: resume + dedupe. P1: deterministic truncation rules + docs. P2: headers, SDK helpers, support playbook.
raj: Scoped plan for P0: require client to send `resume_token` + `idempotency_key` on retry. Server keeps compact per-request state (last_index). If mismatch -> 409 nonresumable.
elena: Edge cases I will enumerate: max_output_tokens, model variant switch, cross-region failover, KV cache mismatch, client replay, stream buffer overflow.
raj: Pseudo retry semantics:
```
POST /generate {idempotency_key, resume_token?, last_index}
Server: if idempotency_key seen:
  if last_index <= stored_index: replay from stored_index+1
  else: 409 {status: "nonresumable"}
```
If nonresumable include `X-Gen-Status: nonresumable` and recommended restart flow.
thomas: Acceptance tests: reproduce truncated->resume deterministic; resume_success_rate >= 99% in synthetic; duplicate_emits ~ 0.
sophie: Support playbook: 409 nonresumable -> show friendly message + restart suggestion. Return body {reason: "nonresumable", action: "restart_request", help_url: "https://redwood.internal/docs/gen-retries"}.
mia: Action owners: Raj -> runtime design doc + perf estimate (due Tue). Elena -> full edge-case matrix + test vectors. Sophie -> support template + customer FAQ. Thomas -> header + SDK changes spec. Tagging eng-runtime, eng-ml, support in PRD draft.
deploy-bot: RFC draft created: https://redwood.internal/rfc/1234 (please comment)
raj: LGTM, will start design doc and flag perf blockers.
elena: CSV matrix uploaded to RFC.
thomas: :thumbsup:
